inputs.declared_question: Does the internal Dear Elsewhere continuity remain accurately placed across its Field Note, Instrument, Artifact, and Builder Note, or does any relation or catalog record require tending?

sources_checked.title: A Place for the Reply exact source

source_facts.claim: Field Note 35 develops Dear Elsewhere as a slow, finite correspondence in which distinct attentions alter one shared surface while earlier arrangements remain encounterable.
source_facts.locator: What the canvas holds; The speed of making, the time of answering; An ending that can still be encountered

source_facts.claim: Instrument I-005 specifies seven addressed arrivals, preserved earlier arrangements, explicit file handoff, a completed interactive relic, and a separate decision for any public life.
source_facts.locator: Pass the surface; Let seven be an ending; Choose what to carry onward

source_facts.claim: Artifact A-005 records a functioning browser and Mac prototype while explicitly withholding claims about durable shared hosting, verified identity, independent security review, or a completed interpersonal study.
source_facts.locator: The object that exists; What this record establishes

source_facts.claim: Builder Note BN-006 documents the shared runtime, seven snapshots, bounded included assets, turn-chain digests, portable exports, and remaining limits around identity, consent, recovery, conflicts, and public publication.
source_facts.locator: One runtime in three places; Seven snapshots; Carry bytes, retain sources; What a commitment commits to; The portable relic and the context view; The next implementation threshold

cartographer.inference: The three existing implementation proposals still describe a legible internal continuity: the Field Note develops the encounter, the Instrument specifies conduct, the Artifact records the working embodiment, and the Builder Note makes its technical commitments and limits inspectable.
cartographer.uncertainty: The continuity is strongly evidenced, but all three relationships remain model-proposed and emerging. The exact sources still identify a lived two-person exchange and shared-service reliability as open validation work.
cartographer.attribution: All facts in this bounded inquiry come from exact public Cyberdelic OS sources. No private repository, private correspondence, or external source was read.
cartographer.no_proposal_reason: The bounded internal continuity is already represented by three strong implementation proposals. No external search or additional candidate was needed, and adding one would expand the inquiry without evidence of a missing relation.

decisions.decision: Keep the three implementation relations because their exact locators remain literal and continue to support the progression from encounter to protocol, working artifact, and technical account.

Keep all three relations emerging rather than active because the exact sources still identify a lived interpersonal exchange, reliable shared service, identity, recovery, and consent boundaries as open work.
Leave the three-item Attending arrangement unchanged and do not create a dated tending page because no node, edge, rationale, lifecycle state, or related-work path changed.

evidence.locator: These are proposed observations. The present evidence comes from software checks and an illustrative study, not a completed interpersonal trial.
Wider device testing, large personal archives, unavailable external sources, and a lived two-person exchange remain open validation work.

gardener.decision_reason: The internal continuity remains accurate, and the emerging lifecycle still reflects the explicit validation limits. No relational metadata change is warranted.

decisions.decision: Keep the four records because each summary, subject set, ordinary-language search vocabulary, question, related path, and evidence locator remains supported by its exact source.
Add no synonyms or questions because the current records already distinguish encounter, protocol, artifact, and technical account without duplicating one another.
Keep directory results bounded to six and the default Library aperture at three works.

librarian.decision_reason: All four records remain accurate and findable through distinct, source-grounded vocabularies. Revising dates alone would not materially improve findability.
